title: The Classified 'Space Bomb' That Could Crack a Planet
hook: A declassified Cold War program designed a nuclear device powerful enough to shatter a small world—and they tested it in orbit.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines forbidden government secrets with planet-destroying scale—irresistible conspiracy fuel.

title: The Star That's Flickering Like a Dying Flashlight—And It's Not Natural
hook: Astronomers spotted a star pulsing at irregular intervals, and the pattern matches nothing in stellar physics—only a deliberate beacon.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'is it aliens?' hook is evergreen, and the irregular pulsing suggests intelligence, not nature.

title: The Asteroid That Passed Closer Than Satellites—And We Missed It
hook: A city-killer rock slipped between GPS satellites and Earth, detected only hours after its closest approach—by a teenager in Brazil.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shows how blind we are to cosmic threats—teenager spotting it adds human drama.

title: The Dark Matter 'Tentacle' That Touched Earth—And Altered Physics
hook: A dense filament of dark matter brushed our solar system, briefly changing the mass of every atom on Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual of a 'tentacle' touching Earth is eerie and easy to animate; physics-altering twist fascinates.

title: The 'Silent Extinction'—Earth Almost Died Without Anyone Knowing
hook: 274 million years ago, a gamma ray burst sterilized 60% of life—and we only found the evidence last year.
why_this_can_go_viral: The phrase 'silent extinction' suggests hidden catastrophe; recent discovery makes it newsworthy.

title: The Classified 'Nightmare Engine'—A Rocket That Never Stopped Burning
hook: Soviet engineers built a nuclear thermal rocket that ignited in a satellite and kept accelerating until it escaped the solar system—no one knows where it is now.
why_this_can_go_viral: Forbidden technology, Cold War secrets, and a rogue object still out there—trifecta of virality.

title: The 'Void Entity'—Something Is Pulling Galaxies Into Nothing
hook: The Hercules-Corona Borealis Great Wall is being torn apart by an invisible force astronomers call 'The Void Entity'—and it's accelerating.
why_this_can_go_viral: Naming an unknown force 'The Void Entity' sounds like cosmic horror; galaxies vanishing is terrifyingly visual.

title: The 'Doomsday Comet' That Orbits Backwards—And It's Aimed at Earth
hook: A comet in a retrograde orbit around the Sun crosses Earth's path every 100 years—and its trajectory is slowly aligning with ours.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'aimed at Earth' framing creates a countdown feel; backward orbit adds strange mystery.

title: The Dark Matter 'Ghost Planet' That Tugs on Neptune
hook: Neptune's orbit has unexplained wobbles that can't be caused by known planets—some say a dark matter world the size of Earth is pulling it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Links dark matter to a tangible hidden planet—'ghost planet' sounds like sci-fi but is real hypothesis.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Filter' That Lies Inside Every Human Brain
hook: A neuroscientist found that the human brain contains a neural constraint that may prevent us from ever achieving interstellar travel—the Great Filter might be inside us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Turns the Fermi Paradox inward—viewers love psychologized cosmic threats that hit close to home.

title: The Star That Exploded Twice—A Supernova That Refused to Die
hook: In 2016, a star went supernova, faded, then exploded again months later—breaking every rule of stellar death.
why_this_can_go_viral: 'Refused to die' personifies the star; double explosion is counterintuitive and astonishing.

title: The Classified 'Solar Pump'—A Weapon That Could Drain the Sun
hook: Declassified documents reveal a 1970s US project to build a satellite that could siphon solar plasma into directed beams—for 'weather control'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sounds like a supervillain device; 'draining the Sun' is existentially terrifying and feels forbidden.

title: The 'Extinction Star' That Erupts Every 26 Million Years—And We're Due
hook: Nemesis, a hypothetical companion star to the Sun, may trigger comet showers every 26 million years—the last one was 25 million years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'we're due' framing creates urgency; the hidden companion star concept feels like a conspiracy.

title: The Signal That Matched a Dead Civilization's Language
hook: A 1977 signal from Centauri A contained a binary sequence that, when decoded, matched a syntax found in ruins of a 6,000-year-old Earth city.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bridges cosmic and ancient Earth mysteries—mind-bending implication that we received a message in a human language.

title: The 'Black Hole Planet'—A World Orbiting Inside an Event Horizon
hook: Theoretical physics suggests planets could form inside a rotating black hole's ergosphere—one may already be there, sending Hawking radiation echoes.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept 'planet inside a black hole' is mind-blowing and visually stunning; 'impossible' world draws deep curiosity.

title: The Classified 'Gravity Mirror' That Warped Time in Orbit
hook: A secret 1990s experiment placed a spinning superconductor ring in orbit, creating a localized time dilation effect detectable by atomic clocks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mixes classified space projects with time warping—a forbidden experiment that sounds like pure sci-fi.

title: The 'Dark Matter Echo'—A Sound From the Big Bang Still Ringing
hook: A low-frequency hum detected by LIGO might be primordial dark matter vibrating from the first second of the universe—and it's getting louder.
why_this_can_go_viral: 'Getting louder' implies imminent change; sound from the Big Bang is poetic and mysterious.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Tombstone'—A Message Carved in a Dead Moon
hook: A crater on a Saturnian moon contains a perfect circle of symbols—possibly a warning left by a civilization that silenced itself.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines Fermi Paradox with ancient alien artifact energy—'warning left by dead civilization' is existential dread.

title: The 'Star That Burns Methane'—A Failed Sun That Smells Like Hell
hook: A brown dwarf in the Oort cloud emits methane spectral lines, meaning its atmosphere smells like a sewer—and it's drifting toward Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gross-out factor + approaching danger = shareable; 'smells like hell' is memorable and weird.

title: The 'Extinction That Happened in a Day'—A Solar Flare Blueprint
hook: In 774 AD, a solar proton event hit Earth so hard that trees recorded it in their rings—if it happened today, it would collapse the grid and kill millions within hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: Historical precedent for modern disaster; the 'in a day' framing makes it urgent and relatable.

title: The 'Alien Graveyard'—A Ring of Dead Probes Around Jupiter
hook: Jupiter's Lagrange points contain debris that some astronomers believe are remnants of a failed alien colonization—thousands of shattered objects in a perfect arc.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual of a 'graveyard' in space is haunting; the implication of failed alien invasion is catnip to mystery lovers.

title: The 'Quantum Signal' That Came From Outside Reality
hook: A photon detected in Antarctica carried quantum entanglement properties that couldn't have originated in this universe—it came from a neighboring dimension.
why_this_can_go_viral: 'From outside reality' is the ultimate curiosity gap; quantum physics adds intellectual prestige to the mystery.

title: The Classified 'Moon Base' That Was Built in Secret—And Abandoned
hook: Declassified Soviet archives revealed a fully constructed lunar base that was sealed and left behind after a mysterious accident killed 3 cosmonauts.
why_this_can_go_viral: Moon base conspiracy is always viral; adding deaths and abandonment makes it dark, forbidden, and cinematic.
